finding: tun-rs 2.8.3 rejects arbitrary named macOS utun devices, while documented paid client and operator configurations use logical names such as octrapay0.
change: Logical macOS names now let the kernel choose utunN; valid explicit utunN names remain fixed requests. The opened kernel name is required for route setup. Doctor checks effective UID through the system id command instead of mutable environment variables.
scope: Source and compile qualification on macOS. A privileged live utun open, route/NAT setup, and public paid forwarding have not been exercised by this gate.
